messages:
sophia: Quick thread to pin the benchmark narrative for launch week. Need something that non-ML PMs and infra leads both get. Outcome: hero visual + 2 supporting panels + clear CTAs per buyer persona (mobile UX, search infra, commerce rerank). Thoughts on visuals and routing?
michael: Propose a 3-part hero: left = ribbon of latency bands (colored bands for p50/p95 with SLA markers), center = treemap of cost composition per slice, right = compact trace comparing short vs long history. Keep numbers explicit and call out measurement conditions.
anna: Design constraints: single hero SVG that works as social image and hero. Use large labels, no tiny legends. For the treemap, show relative share (tokens vs compute vs infra) per persona. I'll mock once we have the CSV. :art:
devon: Routing suggestion: landing page with two immediate interactions: 1) "Quick probe" (paste sample payload or choose persona) -> returns estimated p50/p95 + cost band and suggests CTA (self-serve/demo/contact). 2) Enterprise intake (company, monthly_tokens_est, target_SLA) -> routes to sales. Routing rule examples: `if monthly_tokens_est >= 80_000_000 OR target_SLA == "<350ms" -> tag:enterprise`
ops-bot: bench file uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/launch/2025-11-12/latency-econ-master.csv :link:
michael: Small placeholder CSV to design against (label as sample):
```
model,persona,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,avg_history
swift-lite,mobile_ux,98,230,0.50,20
search-core,search_infra,350,780,0.33,150
sparse-quant,commerce_rerank,185,460,0.11,60
```
anna: UX copy idea for CTAs: Quick probe = "Estimate latency & spend in 60s"; Demo = "Watch a 5-minute replay on your workload"; Enterprise = "Schedule a capacity review". We'll A/B these.
sophia: Webinar concept: "The real cost of real-time: visibility, predictability, action" -> 20m story (bench methodology + key findings), 20m live probe + autoscale replay, 10m Q&A. Speakers: michael (method), devon (routing/ops demo), anna (design + copy). Date: 2 weeks out. :calendar:
michael: Measurement transparency: include a small methodology card on the page: `warm cache, steady-state run, batch auto, seq lengths by persona (20/150/60), QPS target 10-50 for mobile UX, 1-20 for search, 50-500 for rerank`. Add a small asterisk for any <150ms claim: "measured at p50 with history <=32 and sustained 10-50 QPS".
devon: Webhook/CRM payload sketch: `event: quick_probe`, props: persona, est_p50, est_p95, est_cost_per_1k, monthly_tokens_guess, tags[]. Tagging rules: `if est_cost_per_1k > 0.4 -> tag:high_cost_interest`, `if est_p95 < 300 and persona == 'mobile_ux' -> tag:low_latency_interest`. We'll surface tags to Salesforce via webhook.
anna: For hero microcopy: lead with one sentence: "See how the same API call can land in very different cost and latency buckets depending on SLOs and workload." Then three persona cards under hero with the recommended deployment (hosted, dedicated, private) & CTA per card.
michael: Also suggest an inset chart showing "cost per 1k vs QPS" (three lines for models) so finance folks see predictability as load changes.
sophia: Action items: 1) michael = confirm full CSV and include p50/p95 + seq dist by Wed EOD, 2) anna = hero mock + persona cards + methodology card by Thu noon, 3) devon = webhook spec + routing rules doc by Thu EOD, 4) ops-bot = ensure bench CSV is accessible and tag run. Reconvene Fri 9:30 for sign-off. Thanks! :sparkles:
